usage: Conceptual decorative photography for company-page banners; not photographs of actual Yeon Solution premises or completed projects.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: photographic website banner for the company overview of a Korean HVAC and building systems installer. Create one photorealistic, professionally photographed landscape image, 3:2 aspect ratio, wide enough for a panoramic crop. Scene: a refined contemporary commercial office interior, daylight coming through tall glass windows, subtle linear ceiling air diffusers integrated into a beautifully detailed white ceiling, light stone and brushed metal materials, a few restrained indoor plants. The subject is a comfortable, thoughtfully engineered indoor environment. Show physically believable building services and realistic materials; avoid product advertisement closeups. Composition: a wide architectural photograph with quiet midtones in the central horizontal band where a website will overlay white text; architectural details toward the edges, no people. Palette: cool neutral gray, soft daylight blue, warm pale stone. Calm, credible, understated Korean corporate editorial aesthetic. This is a conceptual atmosphere photograph, not a depiction of a specific company office or completed project. No text, no letters, no logos, no signs, no watermark, no embedded user interface, no collage.
